about.title: About Zarev Gold & Coins – Your Trusted Online Coin Shop
about.heading: Preserving History, One Coin at a Time
about.intro: Welcome to Zarev Gold & Coins, your premier destination for rare and collectible coins with numismatic value. Whether you're a passionate collector, an investor, or someone looking to explore the fascinating world of historic currency, our carefully curated selection offers something special for every enthusiast.
about.experience: With a keen focus on authenticity, quality, and historical significance, we provide a seamless shopping experience where every coin tells a story.
about.business_info: We specialize in coins dating back to the 1700s and beyond, offering historical and investment-grade pieces that have stood the test of time. Each coin in our collection is professionally authenticated and graded, ensuring that you receive only genuine, high-quality pieces.

why_choose_us.title: Why Choose Us
why_choose_us.authenticity_desc: Every coin in our collection is verified for authenticity, ensuring you receive genuine, high-quality pieces.
why_choose_us.exclusive_desc: We specialize in coins minted after the 1700s, offering rare finds that hold both historical and investment value.
why_choose_us.guidance_desc: Our team of coin specialists is here to help you build or expand your collection with confidence.

footer.description: Zarev Gold & Coins is your trusted shop for rare and collectible coins. We are passionate about history, craftsmanship, and connecting collectors with timeless treasures from around the world.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.intro: We arrange delivery for each order and confirm the details with you before dispatch.
delivery.shippingText: Enter your delivery address when placing an order. We will contact you to confirm the available courier and delivery option.
delivery.costText: The delivery fee depends on the destination and courier option. We will confirm the exact amount with you before shipping. No delivery charge is collected online.
